steps.say: Continue: remind me what the last thing you did was.

content.text:
The last actual code task was implementing the approved structured-logging plan:

1. **`src/calc.py`** — added `import logging`, a module-level `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)`, and a `logger.debug("<op> called", extra={"op", "a", "b"})` line at the top of `add`, `mul`, and `div` (no handlers, no result/error logging).
2. **`tests/test_calc.py`** — added `test_logs_call_inputs` and `test_silent_by_default` using `caplog`.
3. **`CLAUDE.md`** — added the bullet documenting the `calc` DEBUG logger and no-handler policy.

I then verified it: `uv run --with pytest python -m pytest -v` → **6 passed**, and a manual run with `logging.basicConfig(level=logging.DEBUG)` printed `DEBUG:calc:add called` and `DEBUG:calc:div called`. Since then I've only answered your recap questions — nothing else has changed.
